programme.title: Aitraaz
programme.desc: Directed by Abbas Mustan, this romantic thriller stars Akshay Kumar, Priyanka Chopra, and Kareena Kapoor. Inspired by the 1994 film Disclosure, Aitraaz was both a commercial and critical success.
